verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no general automation feature for setting up autonomous background workflows (triggers, rules or recurring agent actions). Automatic Check-ins are a single fixed scheduled-question feature, which is adjacent rather than user-defined automation. MCP, CLI and skills support lets external agents run on the user's own computer, so these are developer building blocks, not automations Basecamp runs in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
